target: Spoiler-free 100% completion of the original N-Gage 2.0 release, preserving every documented gameplay block, objective, restriction, weapon, equipment function, perspective mode, and mission record

areas.name: N-Gage Route and Preservation
areas.location_cue: The N-Gage 2.0 application menu on compatible original hardware.
areas.note: Use the documented primary version without assuming later ports share its checklist.

levels.1: The original mobile build has its own mission structure.
levels.2: Run the 2008 N-Gage 2.0 release on compatible original hardware or a verified archival installation.
levels.3: Use the N-Gage build as the content authority, preserve the installed package and save data before play, and do not substitute the later iPhone walkthrough because that port changes camera, controls, and chapter design.

levels.1: Short-lived pickups demand reliable directional and confirm keys.
levels.2: Test aiming, firing, reloading, healing, grenades, and the pause key before saving.
levels.3: Verify directional or 4/6 aiming, OK or 5 firing, down or 8 reloading, both healing shortcuts, the grenade shortcut, and the clear/menu key. Reject any mapping that repeats or misses quick presses.

levels.1: Preserved service-era software deserves a reversible starting point.
levels.2: Copy the untouched application save before clearing the first mission.
levels.3: Close the application normally, preserve its complete private data directory, reopen it, and confirm the empty records screen still loads. Keep that baseline separate from active progress.

items.label: Do Not Merge the iPhone Port

levels.1: The later touch version restructures the game.
levels.2: Treat the iPhone release as a separate adaptation, not required secondary content.
levels.3: The chosen-route record identifies N-Gage as primary and finds no exclusive iPhone completion requirement that must be added. Its touch chapters, merchant upgrades, and bonus mode therefore stay outside this pack.

areas.name: Gameplay Block 1
areas.location_cue: A numbered block selected from the N-Gage mission and records menus.
areas.note: The surviving build documents four blocks but not a safe public mission-title map.

items.label: Clear Gameplay Block 1 in First-Person View

levels.1: Use the alternate camera only after learning the route.
levels.2: Finish gameplay block 1 with the first-person option selected.
levels.3: Choose first-person presentation before the block begins, clear every assigned mission without abandoning to the menu, and confirm its completion appears in Records. Repeat individual missions later for missed items or restrictions.

items.label: Clear Gameplay Block 1 in Third-Person View

levels.1: Use the alternate camera only after learning the route.
levels.2: Finish gameplay block 1 with the third-person option selected.
levels.3: Choose third-person presentation before the block begins, clear every assigned mission without abandoning to the menu, and confirm its completion appears in Records. Repeat individual missions later for missed items or restrictions.

items.label: Collect Every Visible Pickup in Block 1

levels.1: Scan each new camera angle before firing at threats.
levels.2: During gameplay block 1, shoot every briefly displayed item icon before it disappears.
levels.3: Aim at each item rather than walking into it. Fire once while the icon is present, check the carried-item menu for registration, and restart the mission immediately if the camera changes before collection.

levels.1: A complete records menu makes cleanup reversible.
levels.2: Finish each available mission once so every replay slot opens.
levels.3: Use the replay-enabling equipment when required, open Records after each new clear, and verify no selectable mission remains blank before declaring the route complete.

levels.1: The reticle rewards patience before firing.
levels.2: Let the aiming marks contract completely, then fire a damaging shot.
levels.3: Hold aim without shooting until the crosshair reaches its tightest state, keep it on the target, and fire once. Use this timing for the single-attack and limited-ammunition challenges.

levels.1: A second health bar replaces your own during escort work.
levels.2: Finish a mission while keeping the displayed civilian health bar above zero.
levels.3: Prioritize any hostile with a nearly full attack timer, avoid grenades when a civilian shares the screen, and heal only when control returns to your own health bar.
